nodes.description: OpenOraclePriceData.data: private mapping(address => mapping(string => Datum)) holding the latest signed price per reporter source and key
UniswapAnchoredView.priceData: immutable OpenOraclePriceData contract used as the reporter price store
UniswapAnchoredView.reporter: immutable trusted reporter address whose signed prices may be stored
UniswapAnchoredView.prices: mapping(bytes32 => uint) of officially stored USD prices (6 decimals) by symbol hash
UniswapAnchoredView.oldObservations: mapping(bytes32 => Observation) lagging uniswap accumulator window start
UniswapAnchoredView.newObservations: mapping(bytes32 => Observation) most recent uniswap accumulator snapshot
UniswapAnchoredView.reporterInvalidated: circuit-breaker flag; when true the raw anchor price is used instead of the reporter
UniswapAnchoredView.upperBoundAnchorRatio: maximum tolerated new-price / anchor-price ratio
UniswapAnchoredView.lowerBoundAnchorRatio: minimum tolerated new-price / anchor-price ratio
UniswapAnchoredView.anchorPeriod: minimum seconds before the old uniswap accumulator window may be rotated
UniswapConfig.numTokens: immutable number of configured assets actually deployed
UniswapConfig.maxTokens: constant hard cap of 30 supported token configs
OpenOracleData.source(message, signature): recovers the signer address from an Ethereum signed message using ecrecover
OpenOraclePriceData.put(message, signature): external entry point that decodes a signed payload and writes it to storage
OpenOraclePriceData.putInternal(source, timestamp, key, value): validates timestamp monotonicity/freshness and writes Datum into data
OpenOraclePriceData.decodeMessage(message, signature): recovers the source and abi-decodes kind/timestamp/key/value with a 'prices' kind check
OpenOraclePriceData.get(source, key): view returning the stored Datum timestamp and value
OpenOraclePriceData.getPrice(source, key): view returning only the stored price value
UniswapConfig constructor: unpacks up to 30 TokenConfig entries into immutable storage and seeds uniswap observation windows
UniswapConfig.get(configs, i): bounds-checked array access returning a zeroed TokenConfig for out-of-range indices
UniswapConfig.getCTokenIndex(cToken): linear scan returning the config index or uint(-1)
UniswapConfig.getUnderlyingIndex(underlying): linear scan returning the config index or uint(-1)
UniswapConfig.getSymbolHashIndex(symbolHash): linear scan returning the config index or uint(-1)
UniswapConfig.getTokenConfig(i): public view reconstructing the i-th TokenConfig struct from immutables
UniswapConfig.getTokenConfigBySymbol(symbol): hashes the symbol and looks up the config
UniswapConfig.getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(symbolHash): resolves a config by keccak256 symbol hash or reverts
UniswapConfig.getTokenConfigByCToken(cToken): resolves by cToken index, falling back to an external CErc20.underlying() call
UniswapConfig.getTokenConfigByUnderlying(underlying): resolves a config by underlying asset or reverts
FixedPoint.fraction(numerator, denominator): builds a uq112x112 fixed point value with a denominator>0 requirement
FixedPoint.decode112with18(self): divides the uq112x112 mantissa by 5192296858534827 to obtain 18-decimal precision
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentBlockTimestamp(): truncates block.timestamp into a uint32
UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices(pair): reads uniswap reserves and counterfactually accumulates price/time products
UniswapAnchoredView constructor: sets reporter, price source, anchor bounds/period and seeds observation windows
UniswapAnchoredView.price(symbol): external view returning the official USD price for a symbol
UniswapAnchoredView.priceInternal(config): resolves REPORTER / FIXED_USD / FIXED_ETH price sources
UniswapAnchoredView.getUnderlyingPrice(cToken): Compound PriceOracle entry scaling the price by 1e30/baseUnit
UniswapAnchoredView.postPrices(messages, signatures, symbols): external entry that pushes signed prices to the oracle then updates the view
UniswapAnchoredView.postPriceInternal(symbol, ethPrice): compares reporter price with anchor and stores or guards the price
UniswapAnchoredView.isWithinAnchor(reporterPrice, anchorPrice): checks the anchor ratio against the configured tolerance band
UniswapAnchoredView.currentCumulativePrice(config): selects the direction-correct uniswap cumulative price
UniswapAnchoredView.fetchEthPrice(): fetches the ETH/USD anchor price with ethBaseUnit conversion
UniswapAnchoredView.fetchAnchorPrice(symbol, config, conversionFactor): computes the uniswap TWAP anchor price
UniswapAnchoredView.pokeWindowValues(config): rotates old/new observation windows when anchorPeriod elapsed
UniswapAnchoredView.invalidateReporter(message, signature): lets the reporter sign a 'rotate' message to activate the circuit breaker
UniswapAnchoredView.source(message, signature): duplicates the OpenOracleData ecrecover signer recovery helper
UniswapAnchoredView.mul(a, b): multiplication with an explicit overflow check via division
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source used for freshness checks, observation rotation and accumulator deltas
ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) builtin: signature recovery that returns address(0) on malformed signatures
External calls to an arbitrary IUniswapV2Pair (price0CumulativeLast, price1CumulativeLast, getReserves) whose return data is trusted
External call priceData.put(message, signature) performed by postPrices before the view state is updated
External call CErc20(cToken).underlying() on a caller-supplied address in getTokenConfigByCToken

Accumulator arithmetic: blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast, nowCumulativePrice - oldCumulativePrice, shifts and divisions where overflow/underflow is intentional
